Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs multiple MS modalities including DDA, DIA, and PRM. However, the specific PRIDE metadata provided (PXD019903) focuses on the DDA acquisition. The overall project is an AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) study of the TNF-RSC signalosome.

scope: Supernatants were incubated from 4 h to overnight with AntiFlag M2 affinity gel (Sigma-Aldrich).
Affinity-purified samples in Urea (8M) were reduced with 5 mM TCEP (30 min at 37 °C) and alkylated with (10 mM IAA at room temperature).
the supernatant was incubated with cross-linked beads (5 mM disuccinimidylsuberate [DSS], Thermo), in 50 mM Hepes (pH 8.0), 150 mM NaCl for 30 min at 37 °C with strong agitation
the supernatant was incubated with Strep-Tactin beads (IBA LifeSciences) for 1 h at 4 °C.
The cleared cell lysate was incubated with protein A beads coupled with antibody raised against a UBASH3B N-terminal peptide overnight on a circular rotor.
